data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that lays out panes in a row or a column with draggable dividers.
data.what_it_does: Lays out multiple panes in a row or column separated by draggable dividers. Supports nesting, minimum sizes, pushing neighboring panes, collapsing panes, and right-to-left layouts without external dependencies.
use_when: You are building desktop or web tools with sidebars, editors, and live previews
You need resizable split panes with minimum size limits and collapse/expand support
You want to save and restore layout pane sizes
avoid_when: You are targeting older Flutter versions below 3.24
You just need a standard fixed-share Row or Column
strengths: Supports any number of panes, nested grids, and collapse functionality
Steady under window resizing, maintaining proportions
Wider hit areas for dragging without affecting layout space
weaknesses: Initial values and sizes must be managed explicitly if state needs to persist across app restarts
